title: Yikyik Trahll
kicker: A charismatic Katari covered in black fur, quick to laugh, and determined to see every Bramble Union village in Sablewood.
hook: A charismatic Katari covered in black fur, quick to laugh, and determined to see every Bramble Union village in Sablewood.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A black-furred Katari wanderer smiles through travel dust, layered in blue beads, bronze charms, rope cords, and village tokens stitched into a patched cloak.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Warmth as a vocation, keeping the roads human by carrying jokes, names, and warnings between villages. Knows by touch which house-charm marks a favor owed and which marks one owing. Fears a world where every road belongs to a toll and every story to an office.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A question to ask A local perspective A grounded reason this place matters
